episodes.title: EXCLUSIVE: Inside Todd Blanche’s Closed-Door SHOWDOWN With Epstein Survivors
episodes.description:
Tara Palmeri breaks down her exclusive reporting from inside Todd Blanche's closed-door meeting with Jeffrey Epstein survivors—a meeting that became a condition of his confirmation process. Drawing on conversations with participants, Tara reveals what happened during the 90-minute session, why survivors left deeply frustrated, and how Blanche responded to questions about the Epstein investigation, Ghislaine Maxwell, and whether the DOJ will pursue additional cases.

The episode also examines Blanche's Senate testimony, the evidence survivors say already exists in the Epstein files, and what could happen next as Congress weighs further oversight.

episodes.title: Ghislaine Maxwell Testified Before Congress — and Lawmakers Reviewed Unredacted Epstein Files
episodes.description:
What would happen if Ghislaine Maxwell testified before Congress and the unredacted Epstein files exposed the full network of powerful figures who escaped scrutiny?

On this explosive episode of the Tara Palmeri Show, Katy Tur breaks down Ghislaine Maxwell's appearance before lawmakers where she invoked the Fifth Amendment on nearly every question, her lawyer hinting at potential clemency from President Trump as the only way she might cooperate. The discussion explores why Maxwell spoke freely for hours with Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanch yet stonewalled Congress, her transfer to the lenient "Club Fed" prison despite her sex trafficking conviction, and survivor accounts portraying her as the more insidious figure in the grooming and abuse of underage girls. Joined by experts including Sam Stein, Tom Dupree, and Sarah Fitzpatrick, the conversation delves into bipartisan elite connections shielding the conspiracy, conflicting explanations around her DOJ meeting, the lack of prosecutions against other high-profile names mentioned in files, survivor frustration with stalled investigations, and the limited fallout in the U.S. compared to international pressure in cases like the UK's.

She was a foreign correspondent for POLITICO Europe, where she covered international affairs, including Brexit. She hosted the Ringer's political podcast "Somebody's Gotta Win" and wrote a column for Puck. Tara also hosted two acclaimed podcasts on Jeffrey Epstein, "Broken: Jeffrey Epstein" and "Power: The Maxwells." Tara currently hosts the Tara Palmeri Show.
